missions.title: SOS Rescue
missions.description: Learn the most critical Morse signals to rescue a stranded sailor.

chapters.title: Chapter 1: The Signal
chapters.narrative: A faint signal crackles through the radio... SOS... SOS... You must learn to recognize the distress call!

chapters.title: Chapter 2: Quick Response
chapters.narrative: You've detected the signal! Now learn S and O to decode the emergency message.

chapters.title: Chapter 3: More Letters
chapters.narrative: The sailor is transmitting more. Learn E and T to understand the full message.

chapters.title: Chapter 4: The Rescue
chapters.narrative: Decode the coordinates using M and N to complete the rescue mission!

missions.title: Spy Mission
missions.description: Intercept enemy communications as a Cold War spy.

chapters.title: Chapter 1: The Briefing
chapters.narrative: Agent, you've been selected for a top-secret mission. Learn A and I to begin intercepting messages.

chapters.title: Chapter 2: First Intercept
chapters.narrative: Your first message comes through. Decode it using N and R.

chapters.title: Chapter 3: Double Agent
chapters.narrative: A double agent is sending coded warnings. Use W and D to decode them.

chapters.title: Chapter 4: Extraction
chapters.narrative: Decode the extraction coordinates to escape before it's too late!

missions.title: Space Mission
missions.description: Communicate with a stranded astronaut using Morse light signals.

chapters.title: Chapter 1: Lost in Space
chapters.narrative: An astronaut's radio is damaged. They're flashing Morse with a flashlight! Learn H and L.

chapters.title: Chapter 2: The Message
chapters.narrative: Decode the astronaut's first message using P and B.

chapters.title: Chapter 3: Rescue Plan
chapters.narrative: Coordinate the rescue by learning V and K.

chapters.title: Chapter 4: Homecoming
chapters.narrative: Guide the astronaut home with precise Morse communication!
